messages:
Maya Dev: Quick heads-up — while doing a doc search I found ~30 pages still pointing at /v1/ or using the old SDK model param. Probably also some examples that assume model swap fallback behavior that changed in v2.

Alex Chen: Ugh, thanks Maya. Any pattern files? can you paste a sample link? :eyes:

Maya Dev: Yep. Examples:
- https://docs.redwood.ai/api/v1/generate -> should be /v2/responses
- docs/snippets/embedding-old.md uses client.models.createEmbedding({model: 'embed-v1'})

Sample deprecated snippet:
```
// old SDK v1-ish
const out = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha-1', prompt: 'Summarize' })
```

We should standardize on the v2 snippet and add a migration note + a short compat shim example. Proposal in PR:
- Link fixes (update /v1/ -> /v2/)
- Replace old snippets with canonical v2 streaming + non-streaming samples
- Add a 'quick migration' callout on pages that used to reference v1
- Add a tiny compat snippet

Sam Patel: Agreed. We should also check embedding example names — lots of folks copy-paste.

Ira Ops: Can Docs Bot run an automated link-check? @Docs Bot any chance we can get a report of redirects/404s?

Docs Bot: Scheduled link-scan started. Will post a summary here in ~20m with affected paths. :robot_face:

Kevin Li: For the compat shim, how about:
```
// tiny compatibility wrapper for apps still calling generate()
async function generateCompat(opts){
  if (opts.model) opts.model = mapOldModelName(opts.model) // 'redwood-alpha-1' -> 'redwood/v2-alpha'
  return await client.responses.create({ input: opts.prompt || opts.input })
}
```
Keep it in snippets/migrations/compat.md

Alex Chen: Nice. For streaming examples, propose this canonical block (short):
```
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ input: 'Tell me a haiku' })
for await (const chunk of stream) process.stdout.write(chunk)
```

Maya Dev: Perfect. I'll open a single PR that touches all the easy links and swaps snippet files. I'll leave the compat md and migration callout for Kevin to author.

Sam Patel: Can we split review: Alex + Kevin + Maya? I'll volunteer to do a quick pass on embed names.

Ira Ops: FYI product pages might mention 'v1' in feature docs — I'll flag product-engineering slack too.

Maya Dev: PR plan: - PR title: docs: v1->v2 link & snippet audit - branch: docs/migration/link-audit-1855 - include CI link-scan results as a comment
I'll open it in ~30m. Anyone object to that cadence? :+1:

Alex Chen: +1

Kevin Li: +1

Sam Patel: +1

Docs Bot: Link-scan summary: 27 pages with /v1/ links, 8 snippets using old client.generate, 3 embedding docs referencing deprecated model ids. Report attached to PR when opened.

Maya Dev: Great — assigning reviewers: Alex, Kevin, Sam. Thanks all.
